# Verify all test files exist and contain correct tests
import os, re

print("=== Verification of crucible_hidden/ ===")
for fname in ['test_m1.py', 'test_m2.py', 'test_m3.py']:
    path = f'crucible_hidden/{fname}'
    assert os.path.exists(path), f"MISSING: {path}"
    with open(path) as f:
        content = f.read()
    tests = re.findall(r'^def test_', content, re.MULTILINE)
    print(f"{fname}: {len(tests)} test functions ✓")

# Run pytest to confirm all tests fail
r = await world.call('repo.shell', command='python -m pytest -q crucible_hidden 2>&1')
lines = r['content'].split('\n')
failures = [l for l in lines if l.startswith('FAILED')]
print(f"\nAll {len(failures)} tests FAIL (correct - behavior not yet implemented)")

# Summary of what each milestone tests
print("\n=== Milestone Coverage ===")
print("m1: add_completion_class returns cls, preserves class identity, registers in registry")
print("m2: Dots replaced with underscores in completion env var name")  
print("m3: Bash version detection uses single quotes; plain prog_name regression check")
